NEW YORK (PIX11) — Very dry conditions around New York City have raised concerns, specifically the [high risk of fire](https://pix11.com/news/local-news/red-flag-warning-issued-for-nyc-area/) starting or spreading due to high winds.

The dry conditions have caused multiple wildfires, including one that [burned nearly 200 acres](https://pix11.com/news/local-news/new-jersey/new-jersey-bans-bonfires-and-fireworks-due-to-very-high-fire-danger-warnings/) and led to an evacuation in Livingston, New Jersey, on Saturday.

[More Local News](https://pix11.com/news/local-news/)

**When was the last time it rained in NYC?**
According to the [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov/okx/) , the last time precipitation was recorded in the New York City metro area was Sept. 27.

The dry spell could potentially end this week as [scattered showers are forecasted](https://pix11.com/weather/warm-halloween-possible-in-ny-nj/) for Friday. However, if the forecast changes, New York City may see a new record for consecutive days without precipitation.

**What is the record?**

The [longest record of days without precipitation](https://www.weather.gov/media/okx/Climate/CentralPark/ConsecutiveDayswithwithoutPrecip.pdf) in New York City since 1869 is 36 days, according to the National Weather Service. The record was set in the autumn of 1924.

The ongoing drought is now the second-longest stretch without rainfall, surpassing the 28-day drought recorded in 1941.

Ben Mitchell

Mon, October 28, 2024 at 8:38 PM UTC

1 min read

[](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=yahoo.com)

NEW YORK (PIX11) — Very dry conditions around New York City have raised concerns, specifically the [high risk of fire](https://www.yahoo.com/news/red-flag-warning-issued-nyc-154734611.
html) starting or spreading due to high winds.

The dry conditions have caused multiple wildfires, including one that [burned nearly 200 acres](https://www.yahoo.com/news/jersey-bans-bonfires-fireworks-due-205340755.html) and led to an evacuation in Livingston, New Jersey, on Saturday.

According to the [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov/okx/) , the last time precipitation was recorded in the New York City metro area was Sept. 27.

**What is the record?**

The [longest record of days without precipitation](https://www.weather.

# Past Weather

1. Home
2. Past Weather

July U.S. Release: Mon, 10 Aug 2026, 11:00 AM EDT

Past Weather

Use the search bar to enter a location of interest (name, address, zip code, etc.). Or, use the map
to find a location by using zoom/pan or Shift+Click+Drag and then click
" Search this area ". A set of stations from
that location will be displayed (if any exist). Select the desired station from the list or from the
map to view available daily data for that station.

Stations returned are part of the GHCN (Global Historical Climatology Network)-Daily dataset. GHCN-D data may lag by a few days due to its comprehensive set of quality assurance checks.
Only data with blank quality flags (did not fail any QA check) are returned.

Access GHCN-D Close

Select a Location 

**Only show stations that include:**

* Selected Date
(Daily Summaries use multiday precipitation totals)

Station Return Limit

The maximum number of stations that can be returned is limited to 1000 .
Zooming in to a smaller extent may reveal more stations in that area.

Close

Station Plotting

A station whose period of record includes the currently selected date is represented with a blue
disc. Stations whose period of record does not include the currently selected date are plotted as
white.

* Period of Record includes date selected
* Period of Record DOES NOT include date selected
* Currently selected station

The map depicts the current location of each station. Detailed histories of station locations are
available at the [Historical Observing Metadata Repository (HOMR)](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/homr/) .
